test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A bought an item for ₹384 and sold for ₹527, and B bought another item for ₹1,264 and sold for ₹1,724, whose gain percentage is more and by how much approximately?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Cost price of A is 384

Selling Price A is 527

Gain = 527 - 384 = 143

Profit percentage of A = 143 over 384 × 100 % = 37.2395 %

Cost Price of B = 1264

Selling Price of B = 1724

Gain = 1724 - 1264 = 460

Profit Percentage of B = 460 over 1264 × 100 % = 36.3924 %

Difference in Gain percentage = (37.2395 - 36.3924) % = 0.84 %

**∴ Gain percentage of A is 0.84 % more than B.**
